description: Derive the workspace directory key from an issue identifier by replacing every character not in [A-Za-z0-9._-] with '_'. The most important portability invariant (Section 9.5, Invariant 3).

vectors.description: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen are all allowed and pass through unchanged.
The three allowed punctuation characters survive.
Path separators and spaces are not allowed and each becomes a single underscore.
Disallowed ASCII punctuation is replaced character-for-character.
A run of disallowed characters yields one underscore each; length is preserved.
